class.name: OcgTopodsFace
class.brief_description: Describes a face which - references an underlying face with the potential to be given a location and an orientation - has a location for the underlying face, giving its placement in the local coordinate system - has an orientation for the underlying face, in terms of its geometry (as opposed to orientation in relation to other shapes).
